origin.basis: Vredestein was founded in 1908 in the Netherlands and has been owned by Apollo Tyres Ltd since 2009 (heritage page).

manufacturing.basis: The product page does not state where the tire is made.

weight_basis: Vredestein size-table weights (black sidewall unless noted).

wet_notes.summary: Vredestein claims superior grip in wet and cold conditions from its extreme-weather compound; no independent wet test of the current version found.

availability.note: Vredestein's Dutch site lists the tire with a dealer finder and no price; other regions not verified.

name: Fortezza Senso Xtreme Weather
positioning: Vredestein's tube-type road tire for wet and cold weather, with the TriComp XWS silica compound and bead-to-bead protection.
caveats: Wet grip is a maker claim; the 2015 lab test of the older Senso All Weather is not applied.
